caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with armrests and an intricately designed backrest. The chair’s frame, including its legs, armrests, and back support, is shown in a brown color, resembling polished wood. The backrest features a shield-shaped outline with ornamental details inside, including symmetrical curls and a central motif, topped with an orange oval shape. The seat of the chair is cushioned and covered in a fabric with green and off-white or pale yellowish stripes. The drawing is rendered on a light beige or off-white background with no other visible objects or details present.
title: Side Chair
